user.title: AlarmeHA
user.description:
Add this once for the whole house. Each person then opens the **Despertador** panel in the sidebar to download the app and activate their own phone.

Enter the external Home Assistant URL that the phones will use (also from outside the house).

ref.description: Alarm identifier in HA (a-z, 0-9, _ and -). For turn on/off/delete, * = all created by HA.
